title: metrics: lazy_static! in mail crate vs LazyLock in smtp crate
description:
Why this issue exists: mail/metrics.rs uses lazy_static! while smtp/metrics.rs uses std::sync::LazyLock (stable since Rust 1.80). The mail crate carries an unnecessary dependency for functionality now in std.

What needs to be done: Migrate mail/metrics.rs from lazy_static! to std::sync::LazyLock.
